captions.detailed: A hub-and-spoke dual-branch motion rig mounted on a circular base. It features a tall vertical mast supporting two discrete cubical hub blocks, one positioned higher than the other. Each hub block supports a tapered, light-grey spoke arm terminating in a small black sphere. The two spoke arms are independent, rotating around horizontal axes in a revolute joint configuration.
captions.instruction: Create an articulated dual-branch motion rig with a vertical mast on a circular base. The mast should support two independent cubical hub blocks at different heights, each carrying a tapered, light-grey spoke arm with a spherical tip. Configure the two spoke arms to rotate independently as revolute joints.
captions.factory: Construct a base assembly containing a flat circular cylinder, a vertical cylindrical mast, and a top cylindrical cap. Create two identical hub assemblies using a Box primitive for the main block, a smaller Box for the hinge bracket, and a horizontal Cylinder for the pivot pin. Build two spoke arms using a tapered Box geometry (or lofted profile) paired with a small Sphere at the tip. Define two revolute joints, one for each arm, rotating about their respective pivot pin axes relative to their hub blocks.
